# Commitment Tracking

`admin.executive_support.commitment_tracking` · v0.1.0 · **draft** · **STUB**

**What did we promise, to whom, by when — and has it actually been delivered?**


> Holding the organisation to its own word. Every promise made in an email, a meeting or a corridor has an owner, a recipient and a due date, and the administrative function is the only part of the company whose job is to remember all three. Tracking is not reminding: the output is a verdict on whether the promise was kept, renegotiated, or silently abandoned.
